subject: Delete dead code "zfree_usable"  (#518)
reason: The change deletes the unused function zfree_usable (and its s_free_usable macro alias) from zmalloc.c/zmalloc.h/sdsalloc.h. A grep of the checkout confirms no remaining callers of zfree_usable or s_free_usable anywhere in the tree, so the function was dead code: removing it changes no command behaviour, replies, memory accounting at runtime, replication, or persistence. This is a pure refactor with no behaviour change, so no scenario is needed.
